'''Ruby Standish''' is an [[ally]].  She first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. She can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Silver Twilight Lodge]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Sneak]]

Draw 1 [[Unique item]] when Ruby Standish joins you.
